title: The Kingdom Satan Founded
description: The Kingdom Satan Founded in Tonic Solfa: the solfa line by line with the words, staff notation, all 5 verses, and a piano to sing along with.
about: The words are by Thomas Hansen Kingo, first published in 1689. The English translation is by Carl Døving (1908). The tune, AU MEINES HERZENS GRUNDE, is by David Wolder (1598). This version of the melody and the words comes from the Open Hymnal Project.
underlay: The king-dom Sa-tan foun_-ded Shall now be o-ver-thrown, For Christ its fall hath soun_-ded, And through His pow'r a-lone Shall Sa-tan meet his doom, And be for aye con-foun-ded; He from the souls he woun_-ded Shall flee in fear and gloom.

lines: For Christ its fall hath sounded,
He from the souls he wounded
Shall flee in fear and gloom.
Our lips with bands of hell,
Can loose those bands full well,
That e'en the dumb may raise
His voice with joy and pleasure
To God his thanks and praise.
To Thee are known full well,
That God it shall not praise;
To hide the light of grace;
Now he my ears doth close
To God I raise my crying
Would cleanse my soul and spirit
